### 1. Total Addressable Market (TAM)
**Definition:** Revenue opportunity if 100% of Swiss SMEs become customers.

**Calculation:**
\[
\text{TAM} = \text{Total Swiss SMEs} \times \text{Annual Subscription Price}
\]
\[
\text{TAM} = 600,000 \times \text{CHF } 600 = \textbf{CHF 360,000,000}
\]

---

### 2. Serviceable Available Market (SAM)
**Definition:** Revenue opportunity within the specific geographic segment the startup can currently serve (German-speaking region = 65% of total SMEs).

**Calculation:**
\[
\text{SAM (in companies)} = \text{Total Swiss SMEs} \times 65\%
\]
\[
\text{SAM (in companies)} = 600,000 \times 0.65 = 390,000 \text{ companies}
\]

\[
\text{SAM (in CHF)} = \text{SAM (in companies)} \times \text{Annual Subscription Price}
\]
\[
\text{SAM (in CHF)} = 390,000 \times \text{CHF } 600 = \textbf{CHF 234,000,000}
\]

---

### 3. Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM)
**Definition:** Realistic revenue target capturing 3% of the SAM within 3 years.

**Calculation:**
\[
\text{SOM (in companies)} = \text{SAM (in companies)} \times 3\%
\]
\[
\text{SOM (in companies)} = 390,000 \times 0.03 = 11,700 \text{ companies}
